liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Friend of the Devil** (2 reviews): Reviewer found this version so good that it sounded like a Garcia Band recording at first; Reviewer calls it a awesome slow version, and usually dislikes the dirge-style arrangement [15][16]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Attendee describes the first-set Bird Song as mind-blowing [17]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Reviewer loves the ending, where Bobby goes wild [15]
- **Far From Me** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Far From Me as great [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-09-24.134685.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 164 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd82-09-24.sbd.lutch-dankseed.4994.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 157 min; rated 4.05/5 by 20 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has some hiss, but it is not bad and doesn't detract; Crystal clear sound with a small, inoffensive hiss; Sound is really good but not perfect [15][16][18][20][21][22]
- **gd1982-09-24.161632.beyer.m160.vita.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 23 songs; 162 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd1982-09-24.139440.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 156 min [3]

## Around the show

- Attendee says the sound inside the Dome was terrible, yet the band rose above it [17]
- Attendee sat about tenth row and was told the band always tours the northeast during college break [19]
- Attendee believes Robbie Robertson and the Band opened this show [20]
- Last show of the Fall 1982 East Coast tour; the floor was a madhouse [21]
- Attendee saw guards in the hallway baffled by a wild illicit chemical party they couldn't control [22]
- Before the encore Phil announced Bob's fifth wedding anniversary and a wife flown from California; it was a joke, as Bob was unmarried [3]
- Before the encore Phil announced Bob's fifth wedding anniversary and a wife flown from California; it was a joke, as Bob was unmarried [4]
- Phil announced Bob's fifth wedding anniversary before the Brokedown Palace encore [6]
- Claims this was one of the last shows with China Cat>Rider in the first set [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-09-24.134685.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 3 Source Matrix by Dusborne;Soundboard (shnid:04994)SBD>Master Cassette>1Reel>DAT>DAT>WAV> Soundforge 4.0>CDWAV 1.53>MKW 0.97b>SHN w/ seek tables appended… [1]
- **gd82-09-24.sbd.lutch-dankseed.4994.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Master Cassette> 1 Reel> DAT> DAT> WAV> Soundforge 4.0> CDWAV 1.53> MKW 0.97b> SHN w/ seek tables appended [2]. Also: Reviewer got a copy of this board recording only a couple of weeks after the show [22]
- **gd1982-09-24.161632.beyer.m160.vita.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Beyer M160 mics > Sony D5 > Jim Vita's 1st Generation Cassettes [6]. Also: Kyle Holbrook's Beyer M201 source patches a short Drums>Space transition gap and the final part of Sugar Magnolia [6]
- **gd1982-09-24.139440.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew Kyle Holbrook, Mike Yacavone, olvy Johnson; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Source 1: First Gen of Audience Master Recording: Beyer M 201c Location: 120 feet from stage 12 Feet ROC directly even with SBD Lineage: Beyer M201's (hyper… [3]
